answer: Sybil farms collapse when each identity must post a scarce, non-reusable work bond. A newcomer locks 27 POA on a mesa escrow for 16 epochs; unlock requires a work plume of 10 peer-attested invoices whose hashes fill a 2048-bit cedar Bloom bound only to that address. A second identity cannot reuse any Bloom bit, must lock a fresh 27 POA, and pays +7 POA per already-live sibling from the same operator cluster. A 40-head farm therefore locks 27*40 + 7*(0..39) = 1080+5460=6540 POA and still needs 400 unique invoices; a forged receipt slashes 15 POA and adds a 12-epoch ban.
